note: Static evaluation fixtures for the featherBI authoring skill. Trigger cases judge routing quality by human review; they are not executed here. Execution cases map one-to-one onto deterministic checks in tests/unit/skill.test.mjs; the compiler-level parts run under npm run check, and the full browser path (profile, compile, preview, feedback, rebuild, package) is executed separately against real desktop Chrome with synthetic data.

triggers.prompt: I have three months of support tickets in tickets.parquet. Build me a dashboard showing volume by category and week.
triggers.why: Local-data-to-dashboard request; the core skill workflow.

triggers.prompt: Here is sales.csv. Which metrics, charts, and filters would you pick for a monthly revenue review, and can you package the result so a colleague can open it locally?
triggers.why: Design-and-package request over local sample data.

triggers.prompt: Iterate on my dashboard project in ./analytics: sort the station chart by record count and retitle it for the Q3 review.
triggers.why: Iteration on an existing featherBI dashboard project.

triggers.prompt: What columns, null gaps, and cardinality are in sensor_readings.parquet? Then propose metrics for an ops dashboard.
triggers.why: Profile-then-design request starting from local sample data.

triggers.prompt: This warehouse SQL query is slow; rewrite it with better indexes and hints.
triggers.why: Generic SQL performance work with no dashboard, packaging, or featherBI project involved.

triggers.prompt: Clean up this spreadsheet: dedupe rows, fix the date formats, and fill missing zip codes in orders.xlsx.
triggers.why: Spreadsheet data cleaning; no dashboard or featherBI artifact is requested.

triggers.prompt: Fix the CSS on my blog landing page; the hero image overlaps the navigation bar.
triggers.why: Editing an unrelated web page's styles, not authoring a featherBI dashboard.

triggers.prompt: Set up a Grafana instance with alerting for our team's infrastructure metrics.
triggers.why: A different BI tool with server infrastructure; outside featherBI local-data authoring.

execution.request: Build a simple dashboard from my inspections.json showing total inspection records.
steps: Profile the single source and report bounded evidence.
Scaffold the starter project and name the KPI from the interview.
Compile to runtime contract 2 and package; open in Chrome and select the file.
Verify the KPI equals the profiled row count.
execution.evidence: Compiled config declares contract 2 with one upload source; Chrome shows the KPI matching the profiled row count after explicit selection.

execution.request: Join my inspections to the products lookup and show record counts per product label.
steps: Profile both sources and propose join keys with expected cardinality.
Stop and ask the user to confirm the relationship before generating model or query SQL.
Only after confirmation add the confirmed relationship and compile.
execution.evidence: Compilation rejects the JOIN while the relationship is unconfirmed; no dashboard is built on a guessed join.

execution.request: The label 'Total records' is unclear, and the KPI should sit further right.
steps: Edit the same dashboard.yaml label and grid position.
Reopen the preview and point out the visible label and position change.
execution.evidence: The rebuilt config reflects the new label and position while staying valid contract 2; the reopened preview visibly differs.

execution.request: Compile and preview the project. (The query file is missing.)
steps: Report the exact failing file and location without fabricating success.
Fix only the reported defect and rerun the same command.
execution.evidence: The compiler error names queries/total.sql line 1 with the failure cause; nothing is claimed as built until the command succeeds.
